title: ChangeBrief
description: Output of solidsdd.brief: structured scope for one change—goals, in/out of scope, assumptions. Return point when later judgment is ambiguous. Not a living product PRD.

change_id.description: Meaningful kebab-case id; must match the directory name under .solidsdd/changes/.

goal.description: What success looks like for this change (problem to solve / outcome).

in_scope.description: Explicit list of what this change includes.

out_of_scope.description: Explicit list of what this change excludes (non-goals).

assumptions.description: Assumptions the rest of the loop may rely on.

success_criteria.description: Whole-change success checks (later mapped by decompose / integration verify). Prefer observable outcomes, not implementation tactics.

open_questions.description: Unresolved items; usually imply low confidence and/or human_gate.
